meta.title: Get Specialist
meta.description: Book trusted home pros across Israel — plumbing, electricity, cleaning, and more. Clear steps, local help, less hassle.

footer.blurb: Get Specialist connects households in Israel with independent home pros. We are the marketplace — not the tradesperson.
footer.emergency: Not 100 / 101 / 102 — for emergencies, call Israeli emergency services.
footer.draft: Privacy and Terms are drafts for product scaffolding, not legal advice. Replace [COMPANY_LEGAL_NAME] and the other placeholders before any public launch.

home.headline: The right specialist. At your door.
home.subhead: Book trusted home pros across Israel — plumbing, electricity, cleaning, and more. Clear steps, local help, less hassle.

1.title: Tell us what you need
1.body: Pick a category, describe the job, and share your address and preferred time.

2.title: Get matched
2.body: We connect you with available verified specialists nearby (auto or assisted dispatch).

3.title: Confirm & track
3.body: Accept an offer, see who’s coming, and follow the job through to completion.

4.title: Rate & done
4.body: Leave a short review so the next neighbour finds the right pro faster.

home.categoriesLead: Plumbing, electricity, HVAC, locksmith, painting, cleaning, appliances, moving, handyman, pest control, and gardening.

verified.title: Verified specialists
verified.body: We aim to check identity and relevant trade details before matching (checks may vary by category).

pricing.title: Know before you go
pricing.body: See scope and price intent in the job flow where available; final terms are between you and the independent pro.

support.title: Human support
support.body: Reach us at [SUPPORT_EMAIL] when something goes wrong.

insurance.title: Insurance
insurance.body: Any insurance or coverage statements are product- and policy-dependent. Placeholder: coverage details TBD; do not assume platform insurance for on-site work until published.

intermediary.title: We connect you
intermediary.body: Get Specialist is a marketplace intermediary. Pros are independent. We do not personally perform the trade work.

emergency.title: Not 100 / 101 / 102
emergency.body: For emergencies, call Israeli emergency services.

home.citiesLead: Sample jobs start in Tel Aviv-Yafo, Jerusalem, and Haifa. A pro is not guaranteed in every neighbourhood.
home.finalBody: Post a job in minutes. Get matched with specialists near you. Track the visit until it’s done.

clients.heroBody: Post a job in minutes. Get matched with specialists near you. Track the visit until it’s done.
why: Clear categories for everyday Israeli home needs.
Verified-pro intent (ID / trade checks where applicable — product-dependent).
Transparent pricing *intent* (see quotes before you commit where the flow supports it).
clients.pricing1: Platform may facilitate payment flows; we are not a bank.
clients.pricing2: Final price depends on the job scope agreed with the independent pro.

pros.heroTitle: More local jobs. Less empty driving.
pros.heroBody: Set availability, get matched to nearby requests, complete work, and grow your ratings.
benefits: Jobs near you across Israel’s cities and towns.
Flexible availability — you choose when you’re on.
Clear job briefs from clients (category, description, location).
Payout stub: platform may facilitate settlement; banking partner TBD.
steps: Create a pro profile and set categories + service area.
Go available and receive offers / matches.
Accept, arrive on-site, complete the job.
Get rated and move to the next request.
requirements: Accurate trade info; licenses where the law requires for your category.
Respectful communication; show up when you accept.
Independent contractor status — you are not an employee of the platform.
pros.trust2: Ratings and completion history matter for future matches.

about.heroTitle: A neighbourhood marketplace for Israeli homes.
about.heroBody: Get Specialist helps people book independent home pros — and helps those pros find nearby work. Clear steps, local help, less hassle.
about.roleBody: Get Specialist is a marketplace intermediary. Pros are independent. We do not personally perform the trade work.
about.citiesBody: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Jerusalem, and Haifa are the sample service areas. We do not guarantee a pro in every neighbourhood.
about.trustBody: We aim to check identity and relevant trade details before matching (checks may vary by category). Any insurance or coverage statements are product- and policy-dependent. Placeholder: coverage details TBD; do not assume platform insurance for on-site work until published.

contact.heroBody: Clients, pros, and privacy requests. This demo form stays on the page — it does not send email.
contact.name: Name
contact.success: Saved on this page only. Nothing was sent.
contact.emails: When these placeholders are replaced, write to support or privacy:

legal.bannerEn: DRAFT — NOT LEGAL ADVICE. Not a substitute for counsel. For internal product scaffolding only.
legal.note: Bracketed placeholders are not real company details. Do not invent a company number. Counsel must replace them before any public launch.

emergency.title: We’re not emergency services.
emergency.body: For life-threatening or urgent public emergencies, call 100 / 101 / 102 (or the appropriate Israeli emergency number). Get Specialist is for non-emergency home services.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That link does not match a page on Get Specialist.

login.title: Pick a sample profile.
login.body: No password. The session and any jobs you create stay in this browser. Switch language any time — the interface follows you.
login.resetConfirm: Replace everything in this browser with the original three sample jobs?

wizard.title: New request
wizard.lead: Tell us the category, what happened, and where. Matching starts as soon as you submit.

errors.details: Add a title (4+ characters) and a description (10+ characters).
errors.place: Choose a city, an address, and a time window.
errors.ack: Confirm this is not an emergency before posting.
errors.session: Log in as a client to post a request.

wizard.addLanguage: Also write this in the other language
wizard.priceHelp: A non-binding hint. Final terms are between you and the independent pro.
wizard.ack: I understand Get Specialist is not emergency services. For life-threatening or urgent emergencies I will call 100 / 101 / 102.

app.wrongRoleTitle: This area is for the other role.
app.wrongRoleBody: Switch to a client or pro demo profile to continue.
app.myJobsLead: Requests on this demo profile, including the sample jobs.
app.availableLead: Open requests waiting for a pro. Claim one to move it from pending to assigned.
app.offline: You are offline, so you will not receive new offers until you go available.
app.noAssignments: You have not claimed a job yet.
app.categoryOutside: Outside your usual categories — you can still claim it in this demo
app.missingBody: It may have been cleared when demo data was reset.
app.rateHelp: The pro marked the work done. Rate it to close the job.
app.waitingClient: Waiting for the client to confirm and rate.
app.notYourJob: This sample job belongs to another client. You can read it; only they can cancel or rate it.

errors.not_found: That job is no longer in this browser.
errors.offline: Go available before claiming a job.
errors.not_claimable: This job is no longer open.
errors.not_owner: This action belongs to the assigned person.
errors.bad_transition: That status change is not available now.
errors.not_client: Log in as the client to do that.
errors.not_pro: Log in as a pro to do that.

app.dispatchBody: Hybrid stub. The request is matched automatically, then a pro claims it here. This is not emergency dispatch.
app.payoutBody: Ledger only. The platform may facilitate settlement later; nothing is paid out in this demo.
app.pipelineHint: Stages run pending, assigned, in progress, then completed. The smaller label is the detailed dispatch status.
app.independent: Independent contractor in this demo — not an employee of the platform. Trade checks are a product intent, not a completed verification.
app.onlineHelp: You are available for new offers.
app.emptyJobs: No jobs on this filter yet.

dispatch.title: Job board
dispatch.body: Every demo job, grouped the way dispatch would see it: pending, assigned, in progress, completed. Nothing here sends a real pro or an emergency responder.
